text: electric air pump. I purchased this to use at a rental that has a lot of blow up pool toys and it worked great. A great relief to trying to blow up stuff yourself!  Having said this, I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.

product_metadata.title: Electric Air Pump Portable Air Mattress Pump for Inflatables, Quickly & Easily Inflator Deflator with 3 Nozzles for Outdoor Camping, Beds, Swimming Rings（AC 110-120V（600W））
features: 🛒RELIABLE and SAFER: 600W unique grenade shape electric pump, high-quality ABS shell protection, multi-functional and silent, allowing you to inflate quickly while ensuring safety! The 1.7m (5.6FT) long power cord and 0.4m (1.3FT) long inflatable tube allow you to use it away from the socket.

🛒MUTIPLE FUNTIONS: suitable for indoor and outdoor, especially outdoor activities. The air mattress pump can help you save inflating time for inflatable pools, air beds, inflatable boats, inflatable furniture, and swimming rings! You can also pump air when you want to vacuum preserve items!

🛒SIMPLE OPERATION: One-button power switch air pump for pool floats inflatables, you only need to insert the inflation head into the air nozzle position when inflating, and then press the switch and wait for tens of seconds. When deflating, put the inflation head into the vent hole, and then press the switch to deflate. Save your energy and have fun!

🛒3 NOZZLES TO CHOOSE: We have 3 nozzles of different sizes in the electric air cushion pump: small size, middle size and large size, you can match and use according to the size of the product air nozzle. Fast and simple. Save a lot of time than manual pumps.

🛒EASY TO CARRY: The 6.9"x5.5"x4.7" air mattress pump is small in size, only 1.1kg, and light in weight. It is convenient for indoor and outdoor use. It comes with a household power adapter, so you can easily take the air pump to any place. Place to provide inflation! (Note: This inflatable pump is not rechargeable, please do not use it for balloons!)
